fact: In July 2025 the Prime Minister opened the New Alamein registry complex and launched a digital link between the Real Estate Registry and the New Urban Communities Authority in 16 new-city registry offices, pulling text, spatial and licence data through the government G2G switch to end paper dealings.
title: افتتاح مجمع الشهر العقاري بالعلمين الجديدة.. وإطلاق منظومة الربط الرقمي بين العدل والإسكان
